# Synthetic AV1 clips

Three short clips for the tests of the AV1 decoder seam (`tests/runtime/av1_test.c`, `tests/test_runtime_av1.py`). The pictures
are generated by `make_fixtures.py` from three plain ramps (luma, and the two chroma planes), so a swapped plane or a stride
error changes pixels. They are not the picture of any game, and no movie of any game was used to make or to test them.

| clip | size | frames |
| ---- | ---- | ------ |
| `clip_200x126.ivf` | 200 x 126 | 4 |
| `clip_201x125.ivf` | 201 x 125 (odd: the chroma planes round up) | 3 |
| `clip_1920x1080.ivf` | 1920 x 1080 | 2 |

Made with rav1e 0.8.1 (BSD-2-Clause with the AOM patent licence; `rav1e.exe` of its GitHub release v0.8.1, SHA-256
`0d24eeb7739831a5700404086171fba46577ce1a506d7f6789c6ae1fc9531ddf`). Only the encoder's output is kept here. The command, for
each clip, run by `py -3 make_fixtures.py --rav1e PATH/rav1e.exe`:

    rav1e CLIP.y4m -y --quantizer 40 --speed 10 --keyint 30 --limit FRAMES --threads 1 --no-scene-detection -o CLIP.ivf

The first frame of each clip is a key frame, the others are inter frames. `.ivf` files hold NUL bytes, so each is listed in
`ALLOW_BINARY` of `tools/check_content.py` and marked binary in `.gitattributes`.

Running the command again may give different bytes for the same pictures (the encoder is not promised to be reproducible);
the tests compare decoded pictures with the generator's formulas, never the bytes of a clip.
